lines.2: 「Never mind that. It's Tuesday, right? Cafeteria time, boys.」
lines.4: 「Then we're eating on the ocean side.」
lines.5: We made a dash for the 'university cafeteria.'
lines.6: Our classroom was on the second floor.
lines.8: Subaru leaped out the window without a moment's hesitation.
lines.9: That stunt was dangerous for Fukahire and me, so we took the stairs like normal people.
lines.11: Crab passed us and jumped out the second-floor window too.
lines.14: 「I feel someone watching me again. You know, that thing I mentioned yesterday.」
lines.15: 「We don't have time for that now. All the good seats will be gone.」
lines.16: 「Subaru will save us. Subaru always finds a way.」
